question: Amit and Deeksha together invested ₹46,800 in a business. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of ₹8,700, Amit's share was ₹2,900. What was the investment of Amit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio of Amit : Total = 2,900 : 8,700 = 1 : 3

Since time is constant, Investment Ratio = Profit Ratio.

Amit’s Investment = (1/3) × Total Investment

Amit’s Investment = 46,800 ÷ 3 = ₹15,600

**∴ The correct option is C.**
